newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Yeltsin doctors meet Wednesday on heart op date.
newsitem.headline: Yeltsin doctors meet Wednesday on heart op date.

text.p: A team of doctors, including U.S. specialist Michael DeBakey, will meet President Boris Yeltsin at around noon (0800 GMT) on Wednesday and will discuss a possible date for Yeltsin's planned heart operation, spokesman Sergei Yastrzhembsky said on Tuesday.
"The council (of doctors) will discuss the date, tactics and the extent of the forthcoming operation," Yastrzhembsky told a news briefing.
